const profile = { candidate_id: 'candidate-demo-001', target_roles: ['Backend Engineer'], skills: ['Python', 'FastAPI', 'PostgreSQL'], location: 'Singapore', work_modes: ['remote', 'hybrid'], consent: { require_approval_before_submit: true } };
return [{ json: { profile, requested_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];
return [{ json: { ...$json, next_action: 'SEND_TO_APPROVAL_CHANNEL', message: `Review required: ${$json.job.title} at ${$json.job.company} (score ${$json.match.score}/100).` } }];
return [{ json: { ...$json, next_action: 'SAVE_AS_DRAFT_ONLY', approval_status: 'NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_DRAFT', note: 'No external submission performed.' } }];
